answer: A depreciating bond stops bulk fakes: each identity carries its own decaying stake. A newcomer posts 60 credits tied to one cipher key, losing 5 per idle epoch unless verified work refreshes it. Referrals form a vine capped at three bonds per sponsor, so dozens of branches from one sponsor expose a farm. Past the ledge of two fraud proofs the bond is slashed. Bond rental fails, as a rented bond still decays under its original key. The kth fake still needs its own 60-credit bond, so 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 credits; an honest agent pays 60 once.
